objective: Teach a same-tokenizer white-box teacher the exact router JSON contract and a frozen target-free baseline policy before attempting OPD into the smaller student.
evidence_boundary: Synthetic SFT states and retrospective real transfer edges may validate formatting, policy imitation, and execution only. They cannot establish scientific routing benefit or authorize promotion.

training_information.prompt_fields: the 12 target-label-free RouterState fields from catalyst-opd-router-shadow-v1

frozen_policy.missing_uncertainty: abstain if either expert predictive standard deviation is zero
frozen_policy.low_source_skill: abstain if source validation Spearman is below 0.50
frozen_policy.out_of_support: abstain if composition support is below 0.15
frozen_policy.experts_agree: use ensemble when normalized disagreement is at most 0.50
frozen_policy.domain_preference: standard_domain_share at least 0.55 favours Standard; at most 0.45 favours MHAR, unless predictive uncertainty strongly disagrees
frozen_policy.uncertainty_preference: an expert is more certain when its predictive standard deviation is at most 0.90 times the other expert's
frozen_policy.cautious_action: rank if composition support is below 0.35, disagreement exceeds 2.50, or source validation Spearman is below 0.65; otherwise predict

synthetic_state_generation.stratification: near-equal frozen quotas across ensemble-abstain and Standard, MHAR, ensemble crossed with predict or rank

real_state_evaluation.baseline: the same frozen deterministic target-free policy
real_state_evaluation.reason: the real outcomes were already inspected during method development and are not sealed external confirmation

promotion_rule: Remain shadow-only regardless of retrospective performance. Promotion requires a newly sealed external programme under catalyst-opd-router-shadow-v1.
